props.heading: Booking takes five minutes
props.intro: Places for summer 2027 open on the first of March.

steps.title: Choose your week
steps.text: The first or second week of July. Both run Monday to Friday.

steps.title: Fill in the form
steps.text: Tell us about you, and anything we should know.

steps.title: Pay the deposit
steps.text: £50 holds your place. The rest is due in June.
